metadata.description: Fork personal de midudev/better-claude: Narrator, Claude tells you out loud what it did; User Tools, a panel for the model, the effort and the narrator; Quick Peek, the paths in a reply become links to preview; Context Meter, context window usage at a glance

plugins.name: narrator
plugins.description: Click ⏸︎ narrator off in the footer, or /narrator, and after each turn Claude tells you out loud what it did, in your language, with the best free voice your system has.

plugins.name: user-tools
plugins.description: A User Tools panel: pick the model and the effort with a click, switch the narrator, Remote Control and Prompt Upgrade. Its name, models and efforts are yours to change in /config.

plugins.name: quick-peek
plugins.description: The paths in Claude's replies become links: hover one to preview it by the pointer, click it to show it in Finder (or your system's file manager).

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: The session's context window fill right above the prompt: gray, then yellow when it is time to /compact, red when a new session is better.
